reason: I need something like this, and the 30-day refund makes it less of a gamble, but I've never heard of this company and I'm being asked to hand over $249 plus a monthly fee for the one thing that cannot fail when Sam is gone. I'd want to see it work for someone like me first.
objection: Will it actually connect at the moment we need it, in a bad area with no signal, and will my child keep it on? A new brand with 50 kits has no track record yet.
would_change_my_mind: A family I know who has the same kind of child has used it on a real wander and it connected, with the founder or an independent reviewer confirming that it works.
